name: @shotlyx/desktop
description: Desktop video editor and local agent workspace for Shotlyx.
author: GuanTou Lab

scripts.pack: bun run verify:ffmpeg && bun run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.pack:unsigned: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false bun run verify:ffmpeg && bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false node scripts/verify-ffmpeg.mjs --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --require-provenance && bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false node scripts/verify-ffmpeg.mjs --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --require-provenance && bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
